biological_status: Conditional scenario simulation; not validated Arabidopsis editing or mosaicism predictions
case_study: Two diploid target loci labeled ABCG18/ABCG19; no actual guide sequences or genome coordinates supplied

assay_calibration.model: Constant-cutting I <-> DSB -> indel model; effective early induction; initial DSB fraction estimated from training data

source.paper: Uncovering the dynamics of precise repair at CRISPR/Cas9-induced double-strand breaks
source.organism_and_assay: Tomato protoplasts; UMI-DSBseq; not Arabidopsis embryonic development
source.data_scope: Authors' public Psy1 example count table. Not asserted identical to the final paper Source Data workbook. No author R code is redistributed.
source.column_evidence: csv2timecourse.R selects time,WT.Sub,indels,preciseDSB,impreciseDSB before renaming to time,y1,y2,y3,y4; predict_models in likelihood_functions.R confirms that order. The repository README describes a conflicting order.
source.held_out: Both 72-hour replicates; all earlier times are training. No random row split.
source.interpretation: Reported effective repair rates serve as transfer/sensitivity references. Cellular expression, target engagement, product release, volumes, division and synthetic repair-allele probabilities remain scenario assumptions.

assay_calibration.profile_interpretation: Descriptive conditional read-count likelihood; not confidence intervals. Two replicates per time do not establish population uncertainty. Finite multistart optimization does not certify a global optimum.
assay_calibration.biological_transfer: These are tomato example-assay estimates, not calibrated Arabidopsis or ABCG18/19 parameters. No cell-lineage or promoter data were fitted.

assumptions: Effective Cas9 protein production in cytoplasm; effective guide production in nucleus. Transcription/translation and guide processing are lumped.
Expression scenarios have a 12-hour production window. Promoter names are not mapped to unmeasured concentrations.

Cells grow to twice birth volume; growth pauses at scheduled division. Unrepaired DSBs delay division; pre-cleavage complexes dissociate before DNA replication. This checkpoint is an uncalibrated modeling choice.
Division partitions free molecules binomially and copies diploid DNA states to both daughters. At most three divisions per lineage; not a whole-plant developmental model.
Three synthetic resistant mutation categories: two disruption proxies, one other category. No sequence-resolved indel or functional-knockout prediction.
One illustrative off-target locus; no genome-wide search, chromatin, inter-locus deletions, viability or tissue-specific developmental model.
Repair parameters transferred from tomato protoplast references/example calibration; expression, target rates, cell-cycle settings and repair-category probabilities are assumptions.

uncertainty.MC_bounds: Per-quantity 95% Hoeffding bounds across independent founders; descendants within a founder are correlated and are not independent replicates. Bounds are not simultaneous across quantities or scenarios.
uncertainty.parameter_uncertainty: Expression/repair scenarios are sensitivity comparisons, not samples from a fitted biological posterior.
uncertainty.mosaicism: Lower event: at least two resolved terminal cells have different synthetic genotypes. Upper event also includes unresolved multi-cell lineages; incomplete repair leaves mosaicism undetermined. Proxy uses synthetic allele identities.
